scope: I03: bounded standalone CRSI risk/exit follow-up. Keep individual indicator program moving; no combinations, HL/SR, ladder or live changes.

exitDefinitions.baseline12h: Unchanged 12h from actual entry. This is the matched baseline for the SAME entryMode, not the rolling clock.
exitDefinitions.stop3: As baseline, OR first completed held minute low<=97% entry. Decision at minute end; fill subsequent minute open plus declared delay. Not guaranteed/native stop fills.
exitDefinitions.timeout6h: Timeout6h from actual entry, plus declared execution delay. No stop or CRSI exit.
exitDefinitions.crsi50: As baseline OR first subsequent completed15m CRSI>=50 (decision strictly after actual entry), plus execution delay. No stop.

entryRules: Reuse I02 exact15m upper95 mirrored lower5 long crossings; into previous>5 current<=5; back_out previous<=5 current>5. Ignore occupied/pending crossings and require a fresh crossing after close.
exitPriority: Execute due exit, execute due entry; if held and no pending exit, previous-held-minute loss trigger first, then timeout, then finalized15m CRSI threshold. Pending exit is never replaced. Entry evaluation follows exits. Stop cannot inspect the current minute H/L/C.
stopLimitation: Observed-minute software loss trigger, not standing exchange stop-market simulation. It can close above or below threshold after a wick/rebound/gap. Include all adverse exposure until fill, including delayed minute. No hard cap, native fill or liquidation claim.
timing: Same fixed seed and complete finalized UTC bars as I02. Zero modeled publication lag; execution0/+1m sensitivity on every order. Full path rerun so early exits can admit new crossings; do not only truncate old winning/losing trades.
ranking: Descending full/zero-delay delta versus each entryMode's unchanged12h baseline. Preserve both entryModes and allcase results; no adaptive parameter selection.
researchScreen: Two descriptive screens, neither deployment approval: profit screen positive own-baseline net delta in every window/delay, no monthly marked regression, positive net and extra-cost stress everywhere, >=30 full/10 recent closes, no equity exhaustion. Defensive screen retains positive/stress/sample/solvency checks but permits up to10% net sacrifice per own-baseline case and at most$500 monthly marked regression (1.5625% of starting equity); requires no worse adverse DD in all cases and at least20% relative reduction in full DD for both delays. These limits are frozen before outcomes, not a live config gate. No stops treated as guaranteed loss caps.
fixedPathStress: Additional5bps eachside applied toactual turnover inclmarkedexit, not an execution rerun.
funding: Excluded becausecomplete settled ledger unavailableafterApril2026. Fees modeled0.055%eachside; notaccount-net certification.
selectionLimit: Entries selected from I02 outcomes; allhistory previouslymined andwindowsoverlap. No untouchedholdout, crossvalidation or p-value claims. Userapproved bounded riskexitpass, not allCRSIexits exhausted. No postresult extraexits or combinations.
programHandoff: Record CRSI's bestprofit/riskcases andlimitations in research/INDICATOR-FINDINGS.md, then RSI next. No stage4indicatorcombination or stage5HL/SR until scoped individualcoverage reviewed.
overlapParity: 8baselinecases must match pinnedI02 sameentry ledgers/months/stats exactly before new outcomes. OldI01/I02sources remain unchanged.
